name: composer
title: Composer
description: The field a player types into, saying the rule before they can break it. Four states on `data-gs-composer`: idle, typing, screening and limited. Three of the four stop a player posting for three different reasons, which is why the state is an enum rather than a disabled flag: a control that is merely disabled tells a player nothing about when it will not be, so `limited` counts down in seconds instead of saying "slow mode". The character counter appears at 200 left and turns warning at 20, with a word as well as a colour, because before that it is noise. The field keeps its text while a message is being screened, so a refusal costs nothing to retype. One reply quote, one level deep, clipped to a line and droppable. Screens nothing, holds no rate limit and starts no clock.
docs: Controlled: `value` and `onValueChange` are yours, and so is clearing the field once a message lands. `onSubmit` fires on the control and on Enter, and never for whitespace alone. Pass `maxLength` to get a counter; without one there is no limit and nothing is drawn. `busy` is the message being screened and `retryIn` is the seconds left on the room's rate limit, and the composer counts what you give it rather than counting down itself, so a host with a limit re-renders with a smaller number each second. Both keep the row the same height as the idle field, so nothing under the player's thumb moves. `replyTo` draws the quote inside the composer and grows it by one row, which is the one push the mobile game frame allows because the player asked for it; pass `onCancelReply` or it cannot be dropped. The composer does not know the room is paused by the host: that is `chat-stream`, which draws the line saying so.
